result_policy.FAIL: Retain exact failure and stop this run for diagnosis/review; no replacement samples or reserve draw.

result_policy.VOID: Manifest proves missing supplied context or actual terminal-before-pause/cancel setup; retain and count consumed calls. Otherwise absent grounded facts or invented particulars is FAIL.
result_policy.inconclusive: Two observation-based unfinished-cancel attempts both terminal-before-cancel: INCONCLUSIVE/VOID, never PASS via synthetic evidence.
